verdict.rationale: The evidence shows web portals for e-filing, public search, status tracking and downloadable statutory forms, but nothing about a published API or a machine-readable spec such as OpenAPI. The llms.txt probe returned 404. A government IP office could plausibly publish an API spec, so this axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes the verdict none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
